performance_case.causal_mechanism: DRA already requires a positive 24-hour close and rising EMA20, but the same endpoint can arise from broad participation across the day or from activity concentrated in a few hours. The complete-day estimated quote-volume Herfindahl tests whether diffuse participation identifies more robust positive-momentum entries before the unchanged next-open fill without changing trend horizon, volume level, price direction, exits or size.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one post-hoc pre-2025 historical mechanism conclusion for exact same-equity DRA V1 with versus without DAILY_QUOTE_VOLUME_HERFINDAHL_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN admission. Historical Validation is not clean OOS and the statistic is not market-wide liquidity or a time-of-day-adjusted volume-surprise model. A positive result retains a prior for at most one separately frozen hypothesis; it is not independent alpha, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization. The task cannot inspect post-2024 outcomes, change a relation, threshold, lookback, concentration statistic, seasonality adjustment, runner or gate, create a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy or mutate canonical state.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The feature is valuable only if diffuse participation rejects fragile concentrated momentum without merely suppressing participation or moving losses into terminal inventory. The frozen equal-capital screen therefore requires PnL breadth, drawdown non-inferiority, holding tails, underwater duration, utilization, realized-lot support and neighbor stability together.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The veto can miss profitable breakouts legitimately concentrated around funding, macro or liquidity events, and the raw daily Herfindahl does not remove hour-of-day seasonality. One frozen screen either retains the proxy for one future hypothesis or closes it before seasonality adjustment, alternate concentration metrics, threshold tuning, OOS access or runtime implementation consumes research capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Under identical 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity and unchanged DRA V1 economics, admitting signals only when the latest complete day's estimated quote-volume Herfindahl ratio is at or below 1.0 of its prior-20-day median will improve fee-adjusted total PnL in Design and historical Validation while preserving realized and unrealized components and maintaining acceptable drawdown, holding, underwater, annual-breadth and concentration paths.
